integrity: All infinite-n conclusions are supported by an explicit derivation and global inequalities, with certified rational finite boundary comparisons. Reproducible verification script supplied; independent mathematical review has not occurred.
limitations: Uniform exactly-four-wall cyclic Ising shell, n >= 5, probability Gram of coordinate Walsh characters only. No arbitrary number of walls, higher-degree band, or Gibbs weights. Historical priority, especially older Ising structure-factor identities, remains provisional.
title: Four-wall cyclic Ising shells: an exact Fourier frame and two sharp extremal-mode changes
